Aggregates pre-computed 2025 311 service-request counts per tract (grp='all') from tract_counts, joins to tracts for names, and ranks all tracts by request count descending with name as tie-breaker and geoid last.
sql:
WITH tract_requests AS (
  SELECT geoid, SUM(n) AS request_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261026_d0a9da'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
    AND geoid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT t.name AS tract_name,
       COALESCE(tr.request_count, 0) AS request_count,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN tract_requests tr ON t.geoid = tr.geoid
ORDER BY request_count DESC, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200
